run_compute_scaling_factors: run the compute_scaling_factors function to fit ScaleFactor modules in a FairChem model using training batches
run_fit_cli: run the fit.py CLI script with --checkpoint and config args to compute and save scaling factors
review_compute_scaling_factors: review the compute_scaling_factors function that fits all or unfitted ScaleFactor modules in computation order
refactor_train_batch: refactor the _train_batch helper to run a forward pass and loss computation without gradients
summarize_prefilled_input: summarize the _prefilled_input helper that uses readline to prefill an input prompt with default text
